seo.title: openIndu Community | Open Smart Manufacturing Ecosystem
seo.description: An open smart manufacturing ecosystem for industrial automation and non-standard equipment: share process knowledge, build tools, and connect vision, control, and industrial data.
seo.keywords: openIndu,industrial automation,open source,PLC,HMI,cross-brand,electrical design,BOM,I/O address table,industrial IoT,PLC4X,OEE,yield analysis,custom automation

hero.titleLine2: Build an End-to-End Open Ecosystem for Industrial Automation
hero.subtitle: Share process knowledge, build tools together, and advance collaboration across vision, control, and industrial data.
hero.chain: Forum → openIndu-vision / openIndu-studio / openIndu-cim + openIndu-platform / PLC Experiment

products.heading: Three Core Projects
products.subheading: Code, forum content, and production evidence are distinct; each repository's LICENSE is authoritative

studio.description: Engineering assets and generation workflows for electrical modules, diagrams, BOM, I/O planning, and PLC/HMI intermediate artifacts. Refer to repository docs and tests for the usable scope.

platform.description: A platform for device connectivity, data acquisition, line monitoring, and traceability. Protocol support depends on integrated drivers, versions, and validated environments; it is not universal coverage.

station.description: A C# industrial station-control application. Motion control · machine vision · barcode scanning · dispensing · laser — the software foundation for custom automation stations.

cta.heading: Join the openIndu Community
cta.description: Start with a field problem, a failure record, or an engineering template, and help build verifiable, reusable industrial knowledge.

stack.l4Desc: Forum process columns: display panels, semiconductors, new energy
stack.l2Desc: PLC programming, HMI, selection, BOM, circuit diagrams, cross-brand codegen
stack.l1Desc: Domestic industrial SoC + openEuler (domestic operating system)

steps.heading: Three Steps to openIndu
steps.subheading: From understanding the full stack to picking the right tool — openIndu gets you started fast
steps.s1Desc: Four layers from silicon to craftsmanship knowledge — see how openIndu connects the whole automation flow
steps.s2Desc: Explore process articles for panels, semiconductors, batteries, and more; content coverage is not validated delivery capability
steps.s3Desc: Pick motion control, machine vision or the IIoT platform to match your scenario

knowledge.heading: A Crowdsourced Process Library
knowledge.description: The forum supports continuing discussion of manufacturing processes and field problems. Content should state sources, context, constraints, and validation boundaries rather than present unreviewed parameters as standard answers.
knowledge.item1Desc: Winding speed, welding temperature, yield optimisation
knowledge.item2Desc: Reflow profiles, placement accuracy, defect countermeasures
knowledge.item3Desc: Bonding parameters, welding standards, quality traceability

openSource.heading: Open Collaboration — Come Build With Us
openSource.description: Code, maturity, and licenses are defined by each project repository. The forum also welcomes field questions, failure records, validation methods, and applicability boundaries.
openSource.item1Desc: Core projects including openIndu-studio, openIndu-platform, and openIndu-vision
openSource.item2Desc: Forum discussions, process parameters, lessons learned
openSource.item3Desc: Add industrial protocol support on top of Apache PLC4X
